book.title: Mistakes Were Made (But Not by Me)
book.author: Carol Tavris and Elliot Aronson

predict.question: Two favorable and eight contrary records exist. Keeping only favorable records yields what favorable share in the retained set?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Mistakes Were Made discusses self-justification and selective treatment of evidence.
modelBoundary: All records are {A}% favorable; the filtered set {B}%. Discarding contrary records changes the denominator, not the original evidence.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This programmed filter does not diagnose dissonance or self-justification in a person.
